Marks execution of amended design combining anti-VEGF then vanexin ahead of planned Phase 2b.
Early safety read supports continued enrollment; safety is gating for dose/phase advancement.
Small cohort; rapid safety signal could accelerate Phase 2b prep but limits efficacy read-through.
Geographic expansion may de-risk recruitment and regulatory readiness for next phase.
Flexibility to adjust regimen could shorten timelines if safety and signals hold.

This is an early clinical execution update in an adaptive Phase 2a ophthalmology program, not an efficacy readout. A larger catalyst would be clear signals of effect or a green light to start Phase 2b with a defined regimen and recruitment plan.
